component.name: Rexling
component.summary: Terminal sessions on a Rex server

description.p: Rexling is an unofficial native client for Superlogical Rex. It shows the persistent terminal sessions on your Rex server, with every split pane live at once.

ul.li: Live split panes, each on its own connection
Sessions and tabs in a sidebar, with what each program is doing
A command palette for commands, tabs, sessions and themes
Themes that colour the whole window
Notifications when a program is waiting on you
